l0GA901oGe4.title: What can Seattle learn from Dutch street design?
l0GA901oGe4.summary: Seattle landscape architect Fred Young gives an hour-long visual tour of Dutch cycling infrastructure, covering design details, continuous networks and how cycling fits daily life in the Netherlands.
l0GA901oGe4.why: HN recommends it as an in-depth tech talk for urban planning, full of small design touches that make cycling safer.

quote.text: It's a great in depth look for anyone interested in this stuff, basically a tech talk for urban planning.

PQmSUHhP3ug.title: The 919 Tribute Tour: On-board record lap, Nordschleife.
PQmSUHhP3ug.summary: Onboard footage of Timo Bernhard driving the Porsche 919 Hybrid Evo to an all-time Nurburgring Nordschleife record lap of 5:19.
PQmSUHhP3ug.why: HN cites it as the benchmark lap record and recommends it even to non-car fans for its sheer speed and precision.

quote.text: If anyone hasn't seen this, I highly recommend it, even if you're not a car fan.

7y1xJAVZxXg.title: Televangelists: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
7y1xJAVZxXg.summary: John Oliver's Last Week Tonight segment on televangelists and the 'seed faith' prosperity gospel. It looks at how US tax law lets preachers extract money from poor viewers, and how easy it is to start a church.
7y1xJAVZxXg.why: HN cites it in threads on churches, tax exemption and religious fundraising, as the go-to explainer on seed faith televangelism.

quote.text: John Oliver did an excellent piece on a new crop of so-called "seed faith" televangelists

0rR9IaXH1M0.title: Jim Jefferies -- Gun Control (Part 1) from BARE -- Netflix Special
0rR9IaXH1M0.summary: A clip from Jim Jefferies' Netflix special BARE in which he comedically dissects American gun culture and gun control arguments.
0rR9IaXH1M0.why: Recommended as a funny but surprisingly persuasive outsider take on gun control, mainly in gun-related threads.

quote.text: I recommend listening to what Jim Jefferies had to say about gun control.

M8F5hXqS-Ac.title: Safe Cycling Showdown - Good vs. Bad City Design - Plus 1 Minus 2
M8F5hXqS-Ac.summary: Not Just Bikes compares the same cycling trip to a hardware store in Calgary and in Amsterdam, using a 'plus 1 minus 2' format. It shows how street design shapes how safe and practical cycling is.
M8F5hXqS-Ac.why: HN recommends the channel for understanding why North American road design makes cycling dangerous and how the Dutch approach differs.

quote.text: Watch the bicycle infrastructure get better as he get out into the Amsterdam suburbs.

B5FxFfymI4g.title: Disruptive Innovation - Clayton Christensen (Part 2)
B5FxFfymI4g.summary: Clayton Christensen explains disruptive innovation using the steel industry, showing how mini-mills beat incumbents from the low end. He argues disruption is not about stupid or bad management.
B5FxFfymI4g.why: HN recommends it as an amazing, clear explanation of why incumbents move upmarket and lose to low-end challengers.

quote.text: Here's part of a great talk from Christensen describing the same logic but in the Steel industry

HMYiktO0D64.title: Part 1 - Training Video for Bell Labs' Holmdel Computing Center - AT&T Archives
HMYiktO0D64.summary: A 1973 AT&T training film made for new employees at Bell Labs' Holmdel Computing Center, when Unix was in its third version and running at 16 computer centers in the Bell System. It shows how users submitted jobs and used the center's machines.
HMYiktO0D64.why: HN commenters share it as a rare, atmospheric look at what working at an early computing center was actually like, including how code was submitted and processed.

quote.text: This is one of my favorites, about people submitting their code to get processed at their computing center

2SdGkkp1aq8.title: Robotic Liberation by PWP (VIC-20)
2SdGkkp1aq8.summary: Robotic Liberation by PWP is a music video demo performed entirely by an unexpanded Commodore VIC-20 and a 1541 disk drive, using only a few kilobytes of RAM and a 16 KB disk. It uses demoscene effects to tell a story.
2SdGkkp1aq8.why: HN recommends it as a showcase of what skilled demoscene programmers can squeeze out of extremely limited hardware.

quote.text: I like that the demo effects are used here to tell a story in addition to being a pure display of coding prowess.

xJ6Ym719urg.title: Joe Rogan Experience #1385 - Paul Stamets
xJ6Ym719urg.summary: A long Joe Rogan Experience interview with mycologist Paul Stamets about fungi, medicinal mushrooms and bioremediation.
xJ6Ym719urg.why: HN commenters recommend it as a long, engaging introduction to Stamets and his fungi work.

quote.text: I recommend listening/watching the JRE episode with him

KT18KJouHWg.title: How They Caught The Golden State Killer
KT18KJouHWg.summary: Veritasium explains how investigators caught the Golden State Killer using forensic genealogy, matching crime scene DNA to distant relatives in public genealogy databases. It also covers the privacy implications of DNA databases.
KT18KJouHWg.why: HN points to it as the go-to explanation of how police can identify anyone through relatives' DNA tests, in privacy and genetics threads.

quote.text: If you haven't watched the video Veritasium did about the Golden State Killer, I highly recommend it.

txZq7Laz7_4.title: Morten Rand-Hendriksen: CSS Grid Changes Everything (About Web Layouts)
txZq7Laz7_4.summary: Morten Rand-Hendriksen argues that CSS Grid changes web layout, showing how to place content in cells independent of HTML source order and reshape layouts with media queries. It makes the case for using Grid now that browsers support it.
txZq7Laz7_4.why: HN commenters say it convinced them to drop other layout approaches and embrace Grid, and cite its advice on fallbacks for older browsers.

quote.text: it has convinced me to stop using other layouts/frameworks and just embrace grid

3t6L-FlfeaI.title: I just want to serve 5 terabytes.
3t6L-FlfeaI.summary: A short satirical video, originally titled Broccoli Man, in which an engineer who only wants to serve 5 terabytes gets tangled in Google's internal resource and production processes. It is the source of the phrase about forgetting how to count that low.
3t6L-FlfeaI.why: Used as a shorthand joke for Google-scale bureaucracy and the difficulty of simple tasks at large companies.

quote.text: here's the video where it originated

n_6p-1J551Y.title: The Cubli: a cube that can jump up, balance, and 'walk'
n_6p-1J551Y.summary: A demo of the Cubli, a 15 cm cube that uses reaction wheels to jump up onto a corner, balance there and fall in a controlled way to move. The video shows these three abilities chained into locomotion.
n_6p-1J551Y.why: Brought up whenever reaction wheels or self-balancing cubes come up, with the jump-up maneuver singled out as the coolest part.

quote.text: I always thought that was the coolest part of the Cubli project.

1nBx-37c3c8.title: Noam Chomsky to BBC-journalist:  "If you believed different you wouldn't been sitting here."
1nBx-37c3c8.summary: A short excerpt of Noam Chomsky telling a BBC journalist that he does not accuse him of self-censorship. He argues that people who believed differently would not have been hired into that position.
1nBx-37c3c8.why: HN cites it as a well-known clip on how structural incentives and hiring shape media bias without conspiracy.

quote.text: if you believed something different, you wouldn't be sitting where you're sitting

nFZGpES-St8.title: OSCON 2011:  Karen Sandler
nFZGpES-St8.summary: Karen Sandler, then Executive Director of the GNOME Foundation, talks at OSCON 2011 about the risks of proprietary, closed-source software in implanted medical devices like her own pacemaker-defibrillator.
nFZGpES-St8.why: Brought up whenever medical device security or open-source firmware in implants is discussed.

quote.text: on her experience trying to navigate the issue of getting a pacemaker-defibrilator, including fairly serious security concerns

wPrUmViN_5c.title: Hackers - Technobabble
wPrUmViN_5c.summary: A one-minute clip from the 1995 film Hackers in which characters trade technobabble about RISC architecture changing everything.
wPrUmViN_5c.why: Used as a running joke whenever RISC, RISC-V or processor architecture comes up.

yDp3cB5fHXQ.title: Plagiarism and You(Tube)
yDp3cB5fHXQ.summary: A nearly four-hour video essay by hbomberguy on plagiarism on YouTube, centered on specific creators who copied other people's work. It examines what plagiarism is and how it went unaddressed.
yDp3cB5fHXQ.why: Used as a reference example of blatant plagiarism, including in debates about AI training and academic plagiarism.
